items.title: AI-music guru François Pachet: ‘It’s no longer the jungle era’
items.excerpt: Flow Machines pioneer François Pachet (the 2016 'Daddy's Car' Beatles-style AI track at Sony CSL) on how AI-music creation has moved beyond its unregulated 'jungle era'.

items.title: Nordic Digital Music Survey reveals latest streaming and AI trends
items.excerpt: Nordic collecting societies TONO, Teosto and Koda's annual survey of listeners in Denmark, Norway, Sweden and Finland adds new data on attitudes to and use of AI music.

items.title: Suno confirms V6 model was trained on ‘creations’ from users, as it blasts latest Sony and Universal lawsuit
items.excerpt: Responding to UMG and Sony's second lawsuit, Suno states its v6 models were trained partly on users' own creations on the platform — a disclosure about where the model's training data comes from.

items.title: Sony Music Group becomes first music company to join AI policy coalition ARIAM – alongside Disney, the BBC, and The New York Times
items.excerpt: Sony Music Group is the first music company to join ARIAM, a responsible-AI content coalition launched in June 2026 with members from film, TV and journalism.

items.title: Believe and TuneCore won’t feed music to Suno without giving artists choice to opt in: ‘The artist must consent first, period.’
items.excerpt: Believe CEO Denis Ladegaillerie details a two-stage opt-in process that lets artists decide whether their music is provided to Suno for AI training.

items.title: Minimal Instruments Nagi Offers A No-Code Route To Building Native Audio Plugins
items.excerpt: Nagi combines a visual node editor, Faust DSP and an interface designer, plus a local AI assistant that generates Faust DSP code or GUI layouts from natural-language requests.

items.title: Free Tool, Amorph, Builds Custom Plugin Instruments & Effects Based On Your Description
items.excerpt: Amorph 1.0 is a free macOS/Windows plugin that turns a written description into working DSP code playable in your DAW; its in-plugin AI assistant takes voice input, and coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor connect over MCP.

items.title: An LLM Flagged 1,632 Videos. One Was Real.
items.excerpt: A team rebuilt its music-copyright triage and found an LLM reading video content flagged four of five videos wrongly; the only reliable signal was who uploaded the video.

items.title: YouTube Music gets more conversational with new AI features
items.excerpt: Announced at Made on YouTube, 'Ask Music' lets YouTube Music users describe what they want to hear in everyday language, alongside a personalized 'Your Podcast Lineup' guide.

items.title: Introducing voice, music, image, and video generation in the ElevenLabs MCP
items.excerpt: The ElevenLabs MCP server now generates voice, music, images and video from inside the AI assistant you already work in, putting Eleven Music generation into Claude-style chat workflows.

items.title: As Some Labels Strike Deals With Suno, Artist Reps Sound Off: ‘It’s the Wild, Wild West’
items.excerpt: As Suno signs WMG, BMG and others for its v6 models, managers and reps for Mötley Crüe, Afroman and more react to what licensed AI training means for their artists.

items.title: Ticketmaster Named the First Music Partner for Meta's Muse AI
items.excerpt: Ticketmaster is the first music partner for Meta's new Muse AI agent, letting users connect their account so the personal agent can handle concert discovery and ticketing.
